senses.gloss: m. (v. preced. articles) a quarrelsome person, disputatious.
units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 6:2">Esth. R. to II, 5</cite> <he>וכי קנת׳ היה ועיבר וכ׳</he> was he (Mordecai) contumacious and one who disregards the king’s decree?—Pl. <he>קַנְטְרָנִים</he>, <he>קַנְטְרָנִין</he>, <cite ref="S01565"><he>קַנְתְּ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Nedarim 48a:5">Ned. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>אנשי גליל ק׳ היו וכ׳</he> the Galileans were quarrelsome and wont to forswear enjoying benefits from one another.
<cite ref="Nazir 49b">Naz. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני שקנת׳ הן וכ׳</he> because they are disputatious, and do not come to learn &c.; <cite ref="Kiddushin 52b">Kidd. 52ᵇ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:11:1">Cant. R. to VI, 11</cite> <he>אגוזים ק׳</he>, v. <cite ref="S00834"><he>קִטְּרוֹנִים</he></cite>.
